mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) indicates inflationary pressures, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month but 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE decreases but 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates growing demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases > 5% in 1 month but 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases > 1% in 1 month but 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is high and payroll employment (PAYEMS) is decreasing, it indicates a weak labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 7% and PAYEMS decreases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If UNRATE > 7% and PAYEMS decreases > 0.5% in 1 month but 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) coupled with a decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals strong consumer demand and accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 2% in 1 month and FEDFUNDS decreases > 0.25%
regime_hint: economic expansion with accommodative monetary policy
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases > 2% in 1 month and FEDFUNDS decreases > 0.25% but 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increases > 0.5% in 3 months but 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO increases > 1% in 1 month and UNRATE decreases > 0.5%
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 1% in 1 month and UNRATE decreases > 0.5% but 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances.
